description:
A personal anime library manager for watching and tracking your collection in real time. Lightweight, powerful, and paws-itively fast. No waiting required!

A pure JS BitTorrent streaming environment, with a built-in list manager.
Imagine qBit + Taiga + MPV, all in a single package, but streamed real-time.
Completely ad free with no tracking/data collection.
Unlike qBit's sequential approach, seeking into data that hasn't been downloaded yet will prioritise downloading that data, instead of simply closing MPV.
NOTICE: YOU WILL NOT BE ABLE TO DOWNGRADE AFTER UPDATING WITHOUT DATA LOSS!
- feat(search): add fuzzy cache matching
  - Search page and resolving series now use the local media cache for better title matching.
  - This requires you to have either "seen" the series by viewing the series details, seen it on your home or search page, or have it on your lists.
- feat(search): add relevance sorting
- feat(notifications): add per-status sub/dub toggles for rss
- feat(ui): client stats player toggle (#183)
- fix(macos): use architecture-specific utp-native prebuilds
  - Fixes uTP connections not working on Intel Architecture.
- fix(ui): stabilize card interactions across input types
  - Require pointer movement for hover previews and clear stale hover on touch scroll.
  - Preserve pen taps, mixed-input activation, and episode confirmations.
  - Fixes small cards not opening details modal when pressing enter.
  - Fixes card preview setting across cards and skip episode prompts when disabled.
- fix(mappings): correct Steel Ball Run
- fix(mappings): enforce episode count validation
- fix(mappings): correct false zero episode detections
- fix(ui): show only valid episode durations
- fix(ui): show correct duration on episode cards
- fix(manager): escape pattern hyphen
- fix(toasts): synchronize progress bars and dismissal timers
- fix(notifications): improve rss dub notification accuracy
- fix(notifications): missed series announcements
- fix(android): dismiss card previews during horizontal scrolling
- fix(android): harden native builds
- fix(updater): stop notification timers during shutdown
- fix(search): use correct provider ids for show my anime
- fix(sync): preserve pending edits
- fix(mal): persist progress updates
- fix(profiles): separate provider identities
- fix(android): handle cold-start torrents
- fix(cache): preserve queued deletions
- fix(rss): skip feeds with blank urls
- fix(rss): restore dubbed release audio labels
- fix(settings): prevent blank and duplicate status rows
- fix(extensions): improve codec exclusions
- refactor(client): modernize ipc and lifecycle handling
  - Modernized communication between the app and torrent client.
  - Reduced unnecessary torrent stats updates to improve responsiveness.
  - Improved subtitle, chapter, and attachment handling.
  - Made torrent removal, cleanup, and shutdown more reliable.
  - Fixed stale torrent information after unexpected torrent errors.
  - Fixed cache retaining untracked files.
  - Improved Android storage handling.
- refactor(torrent): move media mappings to cache
  - Resolved media now travels with the torrent cache.
  - Once a media's files have been resolved, it will not attempt to resolve it again to reduce rate limit issues.
  - Fixes some accuracy issues.
- refactor(settings): group announcements
- chore(android): bump to nodejs 24.22.1
- chore(android): switch minimize for exiting the app
- chore(ui): smaller manager buttons on small screens
- chore(ui): update sidebar arrows (#182)
- chore(deps): drop legacy wasm from electron
- chore(deps): bump to webpack v5.112.2
- chore(deps): bump to electron v45.2.3
  - Fixes some codec issues
- chore(deps): bump to capacitor v8.6.0
- chore(deps): bump to fuse.js v7.5.0
- chore(auth): improve logs
- chore(deps): update
